rows.note: The arm is the third operand of src/core/workspace/typescript-source-query.ts:104: posix.matchesGlob(name, full) || (!/[?*]/.test(pattern) && name.startsWith(full.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/')). No after-T test reaches it: every tsconfig parsed by configureTypeScriptProject has a wildcard include (tests/data/typescript-source-query.test.ts:153,178; tests/app/project-source-tool.test.ts:66), so !/[?*]/.test(pattern) is false and startsWith is never evaluated; the one literal include (tests/work-graph/S8A-file-layer.test.ts:458) is NUL-corrupted and rejected at typescript-light-scan.ts:200 before parsing.
